brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net make a website exploring collusion and cartel copyright and profiteering cultural initiation as social control mechanism during global geopolitical tumult (WWI/II) and how it hindered/spread technologies from their otherwise historical trajectory in the long 20th century etc etc

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@epochai.bsky.social: AI is getting cheaper more quickly than any other transformative tech in history. At a given level of performance, cost has fallen ~47%/quarter since 2023.

That’s 4× faster than DNA sequencing, 6× faster than compute, 18× faster than lithium batteries, and (up to 1973) 54× faster than electricity.
